Final synthesis: convergence likely occurred in Exp 31 at the target-code blocker level, and the detection failure is best explained by contaminated discovery counts plus broken closure state. The next experiment should use a star/blackboard runner, dual-schema ownership, 4 active top-level models as the primary configuration, CC2 3-way internal specialization with simplified dedup identity, and an 8-round base budget with extension to 10 on explicit blocker/trend/escalation evidence. Gamma should stay in the stop gate, but only as a scoped discovery signal computed from the canonical registry.
